description:
Powerful 500W Motor
At the heart of the HITWAY BK27M is a robust 500W motor that provides ample power to conquer city streets and steep inclines effortlessly. Whether you're navigating through traffic or tackling hilly terrain, the BK27M's motor ensures a smooth and efficient ride. Say goodbye to sweaty commutes and hello to a refreshing and stress-free journey.
Removable Battery
One of the standout features of the HITWAY BK27M is its removable 36V 15Ah lithium-ion battery. This feature not only makes charging convenient but also provides added security. You can easily remove the battery and charge it separately, whether at home or at the office. Plus, the lightweight and sleek design of the battery ensures that it doesn't detract from the bike's aesthetics.
28*2.0 Tyres
The BK27M boasts 28-inch by 2.0-inch tires, striking the perfect balance between stability and agility. These wider tires provide improved traction, ensuring a secure grip on various road surfaces, from smooth pavement to rougher urban terrain. Whether you're navigating through the city streets or exploring scenic bike paths, the BK27's tires offer a comfortable and confident ride.
Rear Rack Design
Practicality meets style with the BK27M's rear rack design. Commuters will appreciate the added utility of a sturdy rear rack, perfect for carrying groceries, a briefcase, or a backpack. This thoughtful feature eliminates the need for cumbersome backpacks or panniers, making it a breeze to transport your essentials while keeping your hands free.
Shock-Absorbing Fork
Urban roads can be unforgiving, but the BK27M's shock-absorbing fork ensures that every ride is smooth and comfortable. Bumps and vibrations from uneven surfaces are absorbed, reducing rider fatigue and enhancing overall comfort. Whether you're commuting long distances or simply navigating through the urban jungle, the shock-absorbing fork will make your ride enjoyable and stress-free.
